task: Author request: review the v0.3.70 playtest logs (mastermind and overlord saves) for bad decisions and gaps; teleport use by summons and companions; check the 0.3.60 Blindness-vs-fusion report; assess the drain-aware triage proposal
author: Claude

findings.teleports_never_offered: MaxTeleportCombatants 24; mastermind fights had 25-37 combatants. Also: SpellcastingForbidden under Inspired Rage (Vrock 45/125, Derakni 12/36 decisions); Pure Mage / item teleport (Knight Commander, Evading Steps) outside S2.
findings.inspired_rage_spell_ban: Tome of the Firebird and Mystical Mayhem (KRXLib) reference InspiredRageEffectBuffBeforeMasterSkald (ForbidSpellCasting, ignore feature InspiredRage); exports show the stock chain without a ban. Ban seen only after Camellia starts the song (0 rows before in every fight; fight 2 no song, no ban). Mean chosen value with/without ban: Shadow Demon 35.2/8.8, Nabasu 48.4/7.8, Brimorak 21.4/7.0, Derakni 41.3/23.6, Succubus 23.1/12.2, Vrock 18.7/24.5.
findings.blindness: Plain Blindness never chosen in mastermind; fusions above it whenever listed (39.3/21.3, 55.9/32.6, 42.1/25.8, 64.3/40.1). Native fused descriptor = Spell1|Spell2 (Excruciating Deformation adds Evil|Polymorph); fused spell level = max of parts. Bug: fusions share the native holder blueprint, so CastOutcome failure keys collided across fusions on a target.
findings.drain: Orvath (level 10) drained 2,4,6,8,10 by a Corpulent Spectre in fight 8 while paralyzed (Hold Person, Mass) and died; Camellia (level 2) died to one 2-level touch. No Death Ward or level-removing Restoration in either party.

corrections: SpellEdgeMemory: a recipient's measured spell/spell-like edge per round is subtracted from a spell-forbidding buff's value for each round (AppraiseParts); unmeasured spellbook casters keep 0

LearnSpellBan: a ban buff seen on an AI unit is traced through MechanicsContext.ParentContext to the toggle buff that applied it; that toggle's recipients get the ForbidsSpells part (AppraiseToggleBuffs)
Toggle [Buff] rows list recipients the toggle costs beyond the first three
CastOutcome failure and area-miss keys carry AbilityProfile.FusionIdentityOf

profile_audit.versus_v0370_package: report equal apart from the new V0370-REVIEW section; Fusion matrix and summon detail byte-identical (same inputs)
profile_audit.packaged_dll: report, Fusion matrix and summon detail byte-identical to the checked DLL
